_comment: Soft configuration for figure computations, multiple-comparison families, and historical manuscript reference values used by checks. Figure 4 uses the default MixedLM fits implemented by the figure generator.

figure_4.note: Current policy: default optimizer with no custom starting parameters. Effect estimates are stable; SE/z/p report the default fit.

dynamics_score.definition: log(d_ctrl / d_els) in 2D MDS space; ELS positive = control-like distance larger

figure_5.frequency_model: GEE NB (Fig 3A recipe) with 3 groups, dual-reference (Control-ref + ELS-ref)

cv.WARNING: frame-level split leaks temporal autocorrelation; animal-level split is the leakage-free option

figure_7.feature_note: Only 5 bundled pose features available; full keypoint/pairwise-distance set is NOT in the repo

gold_reference._source: Historical manuscript reference values only; not the current reporting policy.
